newsitem.title: THAILAND: Padaeng venture to seek metal in Burma.
newsitem.headline: Padaeng venture to seek metal in Burma.

text.p: Thai zinc miner and smelter Padaeng Industry Plc will enter a joint venture to explore and develop zinc and copper sources in Burma, a company official said on Thursday.
The company's board had recently approved a joint investment with City Realty Co Ltd to form Asia Investment in which Padaeng will hold a 20-percent stake.
Asia Investment will sign an agreement with the Burmese military government on September 9 for the exploration and development of the project, she told Reuters.
The exploration would be carried out in northern Burma over 1,400 sq kms and may last for 2 years.
The cost during the first year of exploration was estimated at US$400,000, she said.
Padaeng currently needs about 150,000 tonnes of zinc concentrates annually to feed its 73,000-tonnes-a-year zinc smelter in Thailand's nothern Tak province.
It also imports zinc concentrates to smelt.
